items.title: Marcus Mariota: Managing knee injury, uncertain to return
items.description:
The Commanders list Mariota as questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Colts in London due to a knee injury.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Marcus Mariota: Makes visit to locker room Sunday
items.description:
Mariota sustained an undisclosed injury in the first quarter of Sunday's game against the Colts in London and headed to the locker room for further evaluation, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more ana

items.title: DeVonta Smith: Could miss multiple games
items.description:
Smith (hamstring), who has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Rams, is viewed "at very best, questionable" for the Eagles' Week 5 game versus the Jaguars in London, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com

items.title: Baker Mayfield: Could miss up to six weeks
items.description:
Mayfield's dislocated right thumb could keep him out anywhere from 3-to-6 weeks, depending on how quickly he's able to resume gripping the football without issue, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis

items.title: Terry McLaurin: Sitting out London game
items.description:
McLaurin (hamstring) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Colts in London.
